name: @ipshipyard/libp2p-auto-tls
description: Stand-in without ACME. @helia/libp2p imports autoTLS for createHelia's Node defaults; sdn-js builds its own libp2p node and calls createHeliaLight, so autoTLS is never called. The real package pulls acme-client, and with it node-forge (GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv, no patched release) and axios. Calling autoTLS() here throws.
